question: Can new cubic head coefficients add useful prediction without disturbing a trained quadratic anchor and its shared embeddings?
selection: Report all six arms on fixed remaining fresh5 halves and old panels, both raw and existing search-half mapping. Positive evidence must exceed the matched quadratic-head control, not merely zero updates. No strength or convergence claim. Ranks not matched in ancestry.
resource: Sequential BelowNormal bounded diagnostic between game batches, no owner model/checkpoint/training state changes.
rationale: Full cubic training and quadratic projection share embeddings. Fixed bases distinguish interference from absence of signal; four to32 head parameters reduce the small-panel overfit risk observed in the visibility pilot. This is a diagnostic, not a new architecture/gate admission.
